scope: Personal Best A2, Units 5–6, Student’s Book pp. 40–57. The practice papers use these themes and core language at A1.

topics.title: Quick verb review
grammar: Present and past forms of be
Past simple of common regular and irregular verbs

illustration.alt: Two people at a clothing stall with a rack of coats

drills.title: Clothes, hobbies and routines
drills.instructions: Type one word in each numbered gap. Use the verb in parentheses. Then answer questions 5 and 6.

questions.explanation: Use the base form with I for a routine.
After am, use the -ing form for an action happening now.
Add -s for a regular action with he or she.
After can, use the base form.

questions.prompt: What is Eli’s usual weekend activity?
options: He sings with his friend at the market.
He plays an instrument at the market.
He shops for jackets at the market.
questions.answer: He plays an instrument at the market.
questions.explanation: Every weekend tells you that Eli regularly plays the guitar there.

questions.prompt: At the market, you want to see how a jacket looks on you. What do you ask?
options: Do you have it in a different color?
Can I pay for it here?
questions.explanation: Try it on means put the jacket on to see how it looks or fits.

cloze.title: Getting ready for the market
cloze.text:
I usually [1] (wear) jeans on Saturdays. It’s cold today, so I’m [2] (wear) a jacket, too.

My friend Eli [3] (play) the guitar at the market every weekend. I can [4] (sing), so we’re going to do a song together.

illustration.alt: Two colorful houses on a quiet street

drills.title: Homes and town
drills.instructions: Type one word in each numbered gap. The message describes the apartment as it is now. Then answer questions 5 and 6.

questions.explanation: Use any after aren’t to say there are no chairs there.
The preposition is part of the phrase in front of.

questions.prompt: Which room can they sit in without moving any chairs?
questions.explanation: Mia says there are chairs in the kitchen and none in the living room yet.

questions.prompt: The notice says the market closes at 2 p.m. Which bus gets you there while it’s open?
options: The bus that arrives at 2:05 p.m.
The bus that arrives at 2:15 p.m.
The bus that arrives at 1:45 p.m.
questions.answer: The bus that arrives at 1:45 p.m.
questions.explanation: 1:45 p.m. is the only arrival time before the market closes.

cloze.title: Come and see our new apartment
cloze.text:
Hi Sam,

Come and see our new apartment. There [1] two bedrooms, but there [2] only one bathroom. We have some chairs in the kitchen, but there aren’t [3] chairs in the living room yet. When you arrive, look for the bus stop right in front [4] our building.

See you soon!
Mia

interview: What do you do after school?

individual.prompt: Talk about a room where you like to spend time.

pair.prompt: You and your partner have free time on Saturday. Talk about the choices. Ask your partner what they like, give a reason and choose one together.

rubric: Grammar and vocabulary. Use familiar words and sentence patterns that express your meaning.
Pronunciation. Speak clearly enough for your partner and teacher to follow.
Interaction. Listen, respond, take turns and ask at least one question.
Development. Add a reason, detail or example when you can.
